probeFindings.claim: oxlint 1.43.0 `extends` does NOT inherit the parent config's ignorePatterns.
probeFindings.evidence: A probe config containing only {extends: ['../../.oxlintrc.json'], ignorePatterns: ['**/node_modules/**']} printed ignorePatterns = ['**/node_modules/**'] under --print-config; the root's 37 entries (including `e2e/**` and `**/scripts/**`) were absent. So the charter's ignore-inheritance risk is not real on this version, and the e2e = 0 in the first probe had a different cause (P2).

probeFindings.claim: MULTI-PATH DEFECT: `oxlint <pathA> <pathB>` in one invocation is non-deterministic on 1.43.0, and is what produced the wrong e2e = 0.
probeFindings.evidence: Three consecutive runs of `--config scripts/qc/oxlint-units.json e2e scripts` walked 858, 170 and 170 files; `scripts e2e` walked 858 three times. The 170-file runs are byte-identical to `scripts` alone -- e2e is dropped entirely (its 50 findings vanish, total reads 352, which is exactly the first probe's number). The 858-file runs instead stop honouring .gitignore under scripts/ and report 9054 findings. Single-path runs are stable: `e2e` walked 194 files three times, `scripts` walked 170 files three times. MITIGATION: the wrapper issues one invocation per path and sums.
probeFindings.notReported: Not reported upstream to oxc as part of this unit; recorded here as a finding for the parent.

probeFindings.claim: `extends` alone is not sufficient to reproduce the root rule set; the verbatim copies are load-bearing.
probeFindings.evidence: --print-config on the extends-only probe vs the root: 2 of 65 rules lost their option objects (jsx-a11y/alt-text and no-empty arrived as bare severities), and plugins, env, categories and overrides were not inherited at all (5 overrides became 0). With the blocks copied, --print-config of scripts/qc/oxlint-units.json equals the root's for rules, overrides, plugins, env, globals, categories and settings -- all seven compared equal.

probeFindings.claim: An `overrides` entry cannot express the scripts-scoped no-console allowance from a config that lives inside scripts/qc.
probeFindings.evidence: oxlint 1.43.0 matches override `files` globs relative to the config file's own directory. `files: ['scripts/**']` suppressed nothing (302 no-console findings unchanged). `files: ['**/scripts/**']` suppressed 25 and left 277 -- every survivor was in scripts/qc itself, the config's own directory. Globs wide enough to reach them (`['**/scripts/**','*']` or `['**/scripts/**','**/*.mjs','**/*.ts']`) also silenced e2e (its findings fell 50 -> 36). DECISION: the allowance is a `--allow no-console` argument emitted by buildLintUnitsArgs for the scripts path only, so the config's rules and overrides stay byte-equal to the root's and the difference is a single pinned line of argv.

probeFindings.claim: The 170 files oxlint walks under scripts/ are the maintained subset, not a lint misconfiguration.
probeFindings.evidence: `find scripts -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs'` reports 729 files; oxlint walks 170. .gitignore lines 37-72 ignore `scripts/**` and then re-admit a whitelist (qc/, lib/, next/, playwright/, __tests__/, jest/run-jest-lane.mjs, e2e/, maintenance/scan-maintenance.mjs, megameklab-conversion/*.py, three named scripts). oxlint honours .gitignore, so the ratchet covers exactly the tracked-and-maintained scripts surface. The ~559 investigation scripts are out of scope by the repository's own ignore policy, not by this unit's.

probeFindings.claim: oxlint panics when handed a path outside the ignore root.
probeFindings.evidence: Linting an absolute temp directory from the repo root aborted with `panicked at ignore-0.4.25/src/gitignore.rs:232: path is expected to be under the root`, exit 127, no JSON. The integration case therefore spawns the CLI with cwd set to the temp directory and lints `.`; the wrapper resolves its config and the oxlint binary from its own module URL so cwd is free.

design.configOwnership: scripts/qc/oxlint-units.json, owned by R6.loop-harness, per council 2 C5 item 5 (a scripts/qc wrapper, not a second root config no node owns) and council 1 D4 (measure first, add lint:units rather than un-ignoring paths existing receipts pin). .oxlintrc.json is NOT touched: its ignorePatterns, including line 53 `e2e/**` and the scripts/openspec entries, are unchanged, so every prior receipt's root-lint pin still holds.
design.configShape: `extends: ['../../.oxlintrc.json']` so a rule the root adds later still reaches this config, PLUS verbatim copies of rules, plugins, env, categories and overrides because extends alone loses rule options (P3). Only six structural ignores: node_modules, playwright-report, test-results, generated, dist, coverage. Neither `e2e/**` nor `**/scripts/**`, and no ignore entry mentions either word.
design.wrapper: scripts/qc/lint-units.mjs. Pure exports buildLintUnitsArgs({paths,config,ceiling}) -> one oxlint argv per path, and evaluateLintUnits({findings,ceiling}) -> {verdict,findings,ceiling}. CLI resolves the oxlint binary via createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('oxlint') (no npx), reads --format json, counts diagnostics from the report rather than trusting the exit code, prints LINT_UNITS_PASS/LINT_UNITS_FAIL <n>/<ceiling> as its last line, and exits 0/1 with no `|| true`.
design.ratchet: scripts/qc/lint-units.ceiling.json = {ceiling, measuredAt: baseline sha, perPath}. Fixed at the measured count; never auto-raised. Zero would be strict, but the measured count is not zero, so it is not.

estimatePerFile.scripts/qc/oxlint-units.json: ~215 data lines, generated from the root config

risksForTheParent: The ceiling is a count, not a fingerprint: 100 new findings could replace the 100 measured ones and still pass. Mitigated only by the per-path split (a regression concentrated in one tree shows up as a path count change in the output), not eliminated.
The scripts-scoped no-console allowance is a deliberate blind spot. If a scripts file ever must not print, this target will not say so.
The wrapper is not wired into CI by this unit; nothing runs it until a later unit adds it to a workflow.
The units config carries a verbatim copy of the root rules. Drift is caught by the jest pin (it fails), not prevented -- a root rule change requires re-copying and re-measuring the ceiling.

The multi-path oxlint defect (P2) is worked around, not fixed, and is not reported upstream. A future contributor who 'simplifies' the wrapper back to one invocation over both paths silently loses e2e; the pin on the argv shape is what guards it.

preliminaryProbe.by: codex gpt-6, before the usage limit
preliminaryProbe.command: node node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint --config scripts/qc/oxlint-units.json --format json --threads 2 e2e scripts
whatWasWrongWithIt: REJECTED as the baseline. e2e = 0 is not a clean tree: it is the multi-path defect (P2) silently dropping the e2e argument. e2e alone yields 50 findings across 27 files. The probe undercounted by 50 and by 194 walked files.
The probe's own file count gives it away: 170 files is exactly `scripts` alone, while e2e contributes 194 more.
The probe's 352 is nevertheless correct AS the raw scripts-only number, and is reproduced above as rootRulesVerbatim.perPath.scripts.

Its 302 no-console findings were counted into the ceiling. A ceiling dominated by no-console in a tree of CLIs that print by design is close to vacuous; the adopted measurement allows no-console for scripts and the ceiling falls from 402 to 100.

Its stated reason for not relying on `extends` alone was checked and is CORRECT (P3): extends drops rule options and does not carry plugins/env/categories/overrides. Its claim that inheritance was the ignore risk was not the operative problem (P1).
